$comment: An order: the scheduler hands a Backfill to the discoverer. spec/notices.md governs it (section 9); changing it changes that spec.
title: Order

name.$comment: A Kubernetes object's name, as a Backfill's is.

uuid.$comment: A Kubernetes object's metadata.uid, a UUID in lower case.

date.$comment: A date, as a Backfill's spec gives it. The pattern holds each part to its range; the format, which a validator asserts, holds each day to its month.

timestamp.$comment: A time in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds and Z (spec/snapshots.md, section 2). The pattern holds each part to its range, leaving out a leap second, which no service's clock gives; the format, which a validator asserts, holds each day to its month.
